_howto: Elections polled by the Tally ENR / TotalResults adapter (server/src/adapters/tallyenr.js). cid = the client slug (https://{cid}.tally-enr.com); electionId from {base}/Election/GetElectionList?cid={cid}. Every contest of every contest type the election lists is stored: headline contests (U.S. Senate / House / Governor / yes-no measures) of detailTypes are read one by one (GetSingleContestResults, the only call with the vote-type split); everything else comes from one GetContestResults call per contest type, at most once every sweepSeconds. contestTypes (optional) narrows the swept types, and allContests then defaults to false. Measures are statewide only when their type is in statewideTypes. typeHints map a Tally contest type to a level + office key (config/contest-rules.json labels) for contests the built-in rules don't place. contestRules: name rules for this source, tried before the shared ones. Set enabled:false to stop polling. Never use the multi-MB FullDataFile.json.

contestRules._why: an Arkansas County Judge is the county's chief executive, not a judicial office
Arkansas JPs are the members of the Quorum Court (the county legislature)
City-type council seats named only "<City> W2 P1" / "<City> Position 2"
